title: Talking to your manager about workload
summary: Practical ways to start the conversation.
body: You do not have to wait until things are bad. A short, specific conversation early is often easier for everyone.
steps: Pick a calm moment and ask for 15 minutes. “Can we talk about my workload this week?”
Bring specifics: what you are covering, how many hours, what is slipping.
Say what you need: something removed, delayed, or someone to help.
Ask what the plan is and when you will review it together.
Afterwards, send a two-line summary of what you agreed.
